We are seeking a strategic and customer-focused IT Product Owner to support the vision, roadmap, and

delivery of our Distributor and Branch Product Information Portal.

This platform supports the full product lifecycle, including Product Information, Training, Marketing, Sales, and Warranty applications, serving both internal stakeholders and external customers.



A key initial focus of this role will be to support the business transition from JCI to Bosch,

ensuring continuity, optimization, and enhancement of the portal experience during this critical

transformation.



The Product Owner will drive alignment across Product Manager and Development teams

while maintaining strong delivery execution in an agile environment.

They will be working closely with the product manager, development teams, and customers to deliver high-value solutions. This individual will work under the product manager, from ideation through delivery, leveraging

innovative thinking and emerging technologies (including AI) to continuously enhance the platform

and deliver measurable business impact.

This individual will work daily with our development teams to manage the work and will work with the business regularly on user acceptance testing and quality assurance.
